headline: Caputo Promises to End Export Retentions if Milei Secures Second Term
summary: Economy Minister Luis Caputo stated at the Rural Society that country risk remains elevated due to fears of a 2027 government change, promising that an incumbent win under Milei would eliminate agricultural export retentions.
why: Agricultural export taxes significantly impact commodity producer margins and foreign exchange inflows, making fiscal policy commitments vital for sector investments.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Policy pledges regarding export taxes affect long-term agricultural revenues and fiscal projections.
